prose.title: React/DOM Properties
prose.text:
At its core, the Menu component is a regular <button> element. Thus, both DOM and React properties, methods, and events are accessible. To read up on all of the possible DOM attributes and types available for button elements, check out this [MDN Web Documents page.](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button) To learn more about DOM events and methods, you can read more on the [MDN Web Events documentation page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Events).

Also, feel free to read about the [types of React events available](https://reactjs.org/docs/handling-events.html), or see [how DOM attributes change in React.](https://reactjs.org/docs/dom-elements.html) Working in tandem with Styled Components, you also have access to the [as property.](https://styled-components.com/docs/api#as-polymorphic-prop)

Function that will be called to render the visual representation. It will be passed a props object. The props passed are different depending on the menu open state. When the menu is closed, two props are passed: hover and focus. When the menu is open, all menu props are passed to this function. It should return a React element. **Note:** This function will be invoked on every mouse move when hovering.
